description: This Java class 'DiscoveryOnlyWebDriver' provides a 'discovery-only' implementation of the WebDriver interface, which fails fast for any browser operation. It's used for validation purposes to ensure test discoverability without requiring actual browser or driver binaries.

classes.name: DiscoveryOnlyWebDriver
classes.description: A WebDriver implementation that disallows any real browser interactions, used for discovery validation in testing.

methods.name: notAllowed
methods.description: A helper method that returns an UnsupportedOperationException indicating WebDriver operations are not permitted in discovery-only mode.
